d: People consider whether ancient man's spectacular structures were built by humans alone or with otherworldly visitors.
Natural disasters in the ancient world, including volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, floods, and meteor strikes may have originated with the meddling of celestial beings.
An ancient mountaintop fortress in Peru constructed with laser-like tools; temples at Vijayanagara, India harness cosmic energy; an acoustic chamber in Malta enables interplanetary communication.
In 2012, scientists at the CERN laboratory announce the discovery of the God Particle, which may have been left on Earth by extraterrestrial beings and may reveal the truth about human origins.
While ancient myths and legends speak of an ape-like giant stalking the earth, theorists speculate that Bigfoot creatures belong to an alien species that once visited Earth in the distant past.
Considering the possibility that sightings of alien beings or UFOs may be evidence of time travelers from the future.
Sacred entryways to the land of the gods; researchers uncover a mysterious and toxic cave in Turkey; otherworldly creatures appear and disappear in Mexico.

The key to understanding the universe seems to be understanding its smallest components. This program explains some of the strange behavior scientists have discovered at the smallest scales.
Discovering the most bizarre, mysterious and exotic things in the universe, including alcohol clouds floating in space, mini-black holes, pulsar planets and dark matter.
Experts come up with 10 ways the Earth could be destroyed, including swallowing it with a microscopic black hole, blowing it up with antimatter, hurling it into the sun and switching off gravity.
This episode details outer lying planets of Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto and their moons. Using CGI, see what alien life might look like on other worlds.

st: The Day the Moon Was Gone
d: How Earth without the moon would be a very different and desolate place with just four hours of sunlight, giant hurricanes that would last for months and virtually no complex life forms.
This episode discusses the coldest places in the universe from labs on earth to freezing places in our solar system, galaxy and beyond.
